scorecard.rationale: An older-adult placebo-controlled fruit-extract trial found lower Hamilton anxiety scores with low baseline anxiety. Whole-grape powder in a 12-week trial and a Parkinson-model grape concentrate comparison were inconclusive. Dried currants gave discordant open-field and elevated-plus-maze results, and the acute grape juice study has order effects. A later review's favorable rat powder citation traces to a retracted 2013 source and contributes no further direction. Distinct powder animal models remain indirect. The human extract contrast retains minimal easing with no direct raw-grape Parkinson anxiety trial.
